summary.headline: Saturn in the Signs of the Planets
summary.text: Opening of Māshāʾallāh’s treatment of planetary significations in a nativity by house placement, following a list of chapters on planets in their own or another’s terms. Chapter I interprets Saturn in its own sign and in the houses of Jupiter, Mars, and the Sun, with different outcomes for day and night births.
